integrity: The exact complex is reconstructed from the published S6 generators and two facet representatives. Global and local homology computations are exact over F2 and exhaust all 8008 ten-vertex and 4368 eleven-vertex subsets. The published literature supplies the exact-object provenance, vertex minimality, and identification of the full automorphism group.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the standard sixteen-vertex triangulation and mod-two third homology. It does not classify integral 3-cycles, larger-support representatives, or other triangulations of real projective four-space.
title: Facet complements are exactly the minimum \(H_3\)-carriers in the sixteen-vertex \(\mathbb{RP}^4\)
